findings.message: /api/v1/books returns a bare List<BookDto> — a bare JSON array leaves no room for total/page metadata.
findings.suggestion: wrap the items in an envelope record carrying items plus paging metadata (total, page)

findings.message: Query parameter "size" has no upper bound — a single client can request unbounded pages.
findings.suggestion: annotate the parameter with @Max (e.g. @Max(100)) to cap the page size

findings.message: Path variable {BookId} is not lowerCamelCase — keep one variable convention (AIP-122).
findings.suggestion: /api/v1/books/{bookId}

findings.message: Path segment "find-by-id" states the CRUD verb "find" — the HTTP verb already carries the action (AIP-131, AIP-133, AIP-135).
findings.suggestion: GET /<collection>/{id}

findings.message: Variable {id} sits under the action segment "find-by-id" — serve the item under its resource: /<collection>/{id} (AIP-127).
findings.suggestion: /<collection>/{id}

findings.message: Endpoint findBookById (GET /api/v1/books/find-by-id/{id}) looks like an action (non-CRUD) — AIP-136 custom methods read POST <collection>/{id}:<action> (verify manually).
findings.suggestion: POST /api/v1/books:find-by-id

findings.message: POST endpoint createBook looks like a resource create (single BookDto response, no action path) but does not declare 201 Created — verify that this POST creates, and answer 201.
findings.suggestion: @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED) (or return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED))

findings.message: POST /api/v1/books relies on the implicit 200 while creating a resource — declare 201 Created so clients can tell creation from a plain success.
findings.suggestion: declare @ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.CREATED) — or 202 Accepted for asynchronous creation

findings.message: POST /api/v1/books/import exposes the ORM entity Book — the database schema and lazy relations leak into the wire contract.
findings.suggestion: map the entity to a dedicated DTO (e.g. BookResponse) before it reaches the wire

findings.message: Type BookDto mixes reference-id spellings ("ID"-style (bookID), "_id"-style (author_id)) — keep one: <resource>Id (AIP-140).
findings.suggestion: spell every reference id <resource>Id

findings.message: Type BookDto names its own id "bookID" while other types use "id" — keep one self-id convention (AIP-140).
findings.suggestion: rename the field to "id", or align the other types on <resource>Id

findings.message: Field "author_id" is not lowerCamelCase — the payload JSON convention is lowerCamelCase.
findings.suggestion: authorId

findings.message: Field "created_at" is not lowerCamelCase — the payload JSON convention is lowerCamelCase.
findings.suggestion: createdAt

findings.message: Field "created_at" holds a time value as String — clients get no RFC3339 structure to parse.
findings.suggestion: use Instant or OffsetDateTime so the wire format is RFC3339

findings.message: @ExceptionHandler maps the business exception BusinessException to HTTP 500 — a business rule violation is a 4xx outcome, not a server failure.
findings.suggestion: map BusinessException to a 4xx status naming the outcome (e.g. 409 Conflict or 422 Unprocessable Entity)

findings.message: @ExceptionHandler for ValidationFailed answers Map<String, Object> while 2 of 3 handlers answer with ErrorResponse — clients would parse two error contracts.
findings.suggestion: answer with the shared ErrorResponse envelope from every @ExceptionHandler

findings.message: Base path /legacy/reports carries no version segment matching "/v[0-9]+" — clients cannot pin the contract version.
findings.suggestion: add a version segment to the base path (e.g. /api/v1/…), or set the R6xx-01 versionPattern option to your versioning scheme

findings.message: Method getReport is served from a legacy path (/legacy/reports/{reportId}) — migrate the route to its versioned form.
findings.suggestion: move the route under its versioned prefix

findings.message: Collection path segment "loan" is singular — collections use plural nouns so one concept keeps one URL (AIP-131, AIP-122).
findings.suggestion: /api/v1/loans

findings.message: /api/v1/loan returns a bare List<LoanDto> — a bare JSON array leaves no room for total/page metadata.
findings.suggestion: wrap the items in an envelope record carrying items plus paging metadata (total, page)

findings.message: GET endpoint autoComplete declares a request body — many HTTP clients silently drop GET bodies.
findings.suggestion: move the payload to query parameters

findings.message: GET endpoint autoComplete declares a request body (MemberQuery) — many HTTP clients silently drop GET bodies.
findings.suggestion: move the payload to query parameters

findings.message: DELETE endpoint deleteMember declares a request body (List<Long>) — model bulk deletes as query parameters or a batch path instead.
findings.suggestion: move the body to query parameters (e.g. ?ids=1,2) or a batch path

findings.message: PUT endpoint updateMember takes payload MemberUpdateRequest but returns MemberDto — the mismatch looks like a partial update, which belongs to PATCH.
findings.suggestion: replace PUT with PATCH for this partial update

findings.message: PATCH endpoint patchMember takes the full MemberDto payload it also returns — a full replacement belongs to PUT, partial updates send a smaller DTO.
findings.suggestion: replace PATCH with PUT for this full-replacement update

findings.message: Endpoint exportMembers (GET /api/v1/members/export) looks like an action (non-CRUD) — AIP-136 custom methods read POST <collection>/{id}:<action> (verify manually).
findings.suggestion: POST /api/v1/members:export

findings.message: GET /api/v1/members/export returns an unpaginated collection — one client request can dump the whole table.
findings.suggestion: add a Pageable parameter or page/size query parameters to bound the result set

findings.message: /api/v1/members/export returns a bare List<MemberDto> — a bare JSON array leaves no room for total/page metadata.
findings.suggestion: wrap the items in an envelope record carrying items plus paging metadata (total, page)

findings.message: Method name "demoBadGetOrder" carries the demoBad fixture marker — name the operation after what it does.
findings.suggestion: getOrder

findings.message: Method demoBadGetOrder declares no response type — clients cannot deserialize an undeclared result.
Method archiveOrder declares no response type — clients cannot deserialize an undeclared result.
rpc DoMagic in service LibraryService is not a Standard Method name (Get*/List*/Create*/Update*/Delete*) or a VerbNoun custom method — the name leaks into every generated client.
findings.suggestion: rename the rpc to a Standard Method form or a <Verb><Noun> custom method (AIP-136), or allow-list the name in the R6xx-02 config with a reason
